For Grafana Alloy, the pipeline config goes in `alloy.configMap.content` in your values file. The language is River (`.alloy` syntax) — component declarations look like `otelcol.receiver.otlp "default" { ... }`. Run `helm show values grafana/alloy` to see where to set it.

An Alloy pipeline has three stages connected via `output { }` blocks: (1) `otelcol.receiver.otlp` receives data, (2) `otelcol.processor.batch` or `otelcol.processor.memory_limiter` applies back-pressure, (3) `otelcol.exporter.otlp` (or loki/prometheus) sends it out. Wire them by referencing the next component's `.input` in each `output {}` block.

Install with: `helm install alloy grafana/alloy -n dojo-lgtm -f alloy-values.yaml`. The ConfigMap that the chart creates from `alloy.configMap.content` will be named `alloy` and labeled `app.kubernetes.io/name=alloy`. The verifier looks for the words `receiver`, `processor`, and `exporter` in that ConfigMap's data.
